headline: UAE residents' update: Flight cancellations, Trump warning on Iran, Saudi Arabia-Houthi tensions
summary: UAE residents face flight disruptions as US-Iran tensions escalate, with effects on Gulf security, aviation and energy markets. Travellers are advised to check airline updates.
why: The UAE is a major Gulf aviation and trade hub, and Gulf security tensions affect oil supply expectations and airline operations.
